prompt: Five photos of equal width are hung in a row on a wall that is 300 centimeters wide. There is a 15-centimeter space between each pair of neighboring photos and a 60-centimeter space between each end of the wall and the nearest photo. The photos are taken down, and 4 of them are rehung in a row on the same wall so that the 5 spaces (the 3 spaces between neighboring photos and the 2 spaces at the ends of the wall) are all equal. What is the width, in centimeters, of each of these spaces?

A metal part is removed from an oven and left to cool in a room. The temperature of the part, in degrees Fahrenheit, t minutes after it is removed is modeled by T(t) = 72 + k(1/2)^(t/8), where k is a constant. According to the model, the temperature of the part is 92 degrees Fahrenheit 24 minutes after it is removed. What was the temperature of the part, in degrees Fahrenheit, at the moment it was removed from the oven?

Lina gives her friends these instructions.

Pick any number. Add 8 to it. Multiply the sum by a. Subtract 10 from the product. Divide the result by 2. Finally, subtract 4 times the number you picked.

In the instructions, a is a constant. Lina chose a so that the final result is the same number no matter which number is picked. What is that final result?

For a quadratic function f, the outputs at x = -3 and at x = 13 are equal, and the output at x = 8 is 48 more than the output at x = 4. How much greater is the output at x = 12 than the output at x = 7?

5^(x + y) = 72
5^(x - y) = 8
Based on these two equations, what is the sum of the two numbers 5^x and 5^y ?
In the xy-plane, line l has equation 2x + y = -10, and point P has coordinates (5, 10). Point Q lies on line l, and no other point on line l is closer to P than Q is. What is the x-coordinate of Q?

f(x) + f(4 - x) = 6
f(4x) = 4f(x) + 6

According to this model, what mass, in grams, would make the spring twice as long as it is with no mass hanging from it?

In a board game, every gold token is worth the same number of points, and every silver token is worth the same number of points. A player holding 4 gold tokens and 12 silver tokens has 52 points in all, and a player holding 5 gold tokens and 10 silver tokens has 55 points in all. How many silver tokens are worth the same number of points as 6 gold tokens?

When thermometer A reads 4 degrees, thermometer B reads 31 degrees, and when thermometer A reads 19 degrees, thermometer B reads 37 degrees. At what reading of thermometer A will the two thermometers show the same reading?
